pythonEnvironment.note: This records the known fixed-local environment as an expected environment only. E-020 must verify it again before generating its own execution lock. No prior experiment lock may be reused.

infrastructureValidation.note: Only non-formal infrastructure validation using fixture seeds outside the E-020 formal seed range is allowed before explicit E-020 formal authorization.

allowedBeforeFormalAuthorization: small deterministic fixtures outside the E-020 formal seed block
runtime benchmarking that does not use the E-020 formal seed block
prohibitedBeforeFormalAuthorization: generation of any E-020 formal corpus game
use of E-020 formal seeds 20275001-20279500 for outcome inspection
generation of an E-020 execution lock with prepared-approved status
reuse of any E-011, E-017, E-018, or E-019 approval token or execution lock
relaxation of preregistered N, seed range, endpoint, direction, minimum discordants, alpha, or decision rule
activationRule: formalExecutionAllowed may become true only after infrastructure validation is complete and a separate explicit user instruction specific to E-020 authorizes fixed-local formal execution. General research continuation instructions and prior experiment approvals do not count as E-020 formal authorization.
formalLockRule: After E-020-specific approval, create a new fixed-local execution lock that records the then-current source commit, preregistration SHA-256, execution-policy SHA-256, runtime, hardware, repository state, exact corpus conditions, and approval-token hash. No prior lock may be reused.
changePolicy: Changing runtime requirements, repository path, approval semantics, sample size, seed range, search-profile conditions, depth/evaluator, primary endpoint, McNemar rule, prospective direction, minimum discordants, decision contract, or output contract requires a new policy/preregistration version as applicable. Infrastructure-only implementation changes are allowed before formal lock but must be frozen into the source commit used by the E-020 lock.
